name: Zettelkasten
description: Prompts only: one idea per note, and a tag vocabulary that keeps captures sortable.

prompts.style_guide:
One idea per note. Write in the first person and keep the present tense. Prefer a concrete noun over an abstraction. Never restate the note back as a summary — if a sentence could apply to any other note, cut it.

Keep headings short. Use a dash list for anything with an order. Link related notes by title rather than by describing them.
prompts.preferred_tags: inbox, idea, reference, question, person, project, meeting, log
